# 2008A Question 4 {.unnumbered}

::: {.exam-question}
## Question {.question-label}

[**Outline**]{.task-verb} the pharmacologic management if bronchoconstriction in acute severe asthma. [**Include**]{.task-verb} mechanisms of action and potential adverse effects.
:::

:::: {#answer-structure}

## Suggested Structure

[**Outline**]{.task-verb} the major drug classes in a table. [**Include**]{.task-verb} a representative drug and route, its mechanism of action and important adverse effects.

::: {.structure-table}
| Drug Class | Example and Route | Mechanism | Adverse Effects |
|---|---|---|---|
| Beta-2 Agonists | | | |
| Corticosteroids | | | |
| Anticholinergics | | | |
| Methylxanthines | | | |
| Other Agents | | | |
:::

::::

## Examiner Comments

::: {.examiner-comments}
**79%** of candidates passed this question.

This question was asked in an earlier examination and comments from the examiner’s report remain relevant.

The main points to be covered included:

- A list of the main drugs useful in this situation
- An example in each group and its route(s) of administration
- Sufficient detail on how the drug works
- Important side effects

It was expected that most of the answer would be on B2 agonists, including the use of less selective agents eg adrenaline, steroids, anti-cholinergics and methylxanthines. Additional marks were also given for notes on magnesium sulphate, ketamine, volatiles, oxygen and heliox.

Some information on 2^nd^ messengers was expected, here some candidates were confused with the inhibition of cAMP and the direction of intracellular calcium fluxes. Some candidates failed to gain marks by not mentioning a mechanism of action or side effects. There were some excellent answers that used a table format, succinctly giving detailed and relevant information. Extra marks were given for answers that showed some perspective eg minimal side effects of ipratropium if given by metered aerosol.

Some candidates used time to discuss the pathogenesis of asthma, which attracted no marks. Insufficient detail and main points not covered were the main reasons for failing this question.
:::
